jobs.description: Centralize AppFactory jobs, orchestrator health, human intervention notifications, and delivery artifacts in one operations view.

runtimeMode.title: Current execution mode
runtimeMode.enabled: Builder runtime is enabled. New jobs will prefer the real model-driven edit pipeline, using {{defaultModel}} as the default model and {{upgradeModel}} as the upgrade model.
runtimeMode.disabled: The system is still using thin executor fallback. New jobs will only validate the input bundle and probe file, not run a real Flutter build.

create.title: Create job

advanced.description: Only keep the two controls that change creation guardrails and auto-start policy. The section stays collapsed by default.

autoStartBuilder.label: Auto-start after creation
autoStartBuilder.description: When disabled, the flow only creates the job record and skips builder registration and execution start.

builderRuntimePatchParse.title: Builder runtime patch parse failed
builderRuntimePatchParse.description: Builder runtime returned a WorkspacePatch, but the runtime could not parse it safely. Check builder-output, the summary log, and the event stream first for malformed JSON, conflicting operation shapes, or replace_block entries without replacements.

workspacePatchApply.title: WorkspacePatch apply failed
workspacePatchApply.description: The patch parsed successfully, but failed while being applied to the workspace. Inspect builder-output and the event stream first to confirm whether the patch targeted missing files, escaped allowed paths, or hit target-file delete protection.

environmentCheck.title: Real build validation failed
environmentCheck.description: The real Flutter validation failed during an environment or build step. Inspect build-report / smoke-test-report first, then use failure category {{category}} to determine whether pub, analyze, test, or build failed.

deviceCheck.title: Device verification failed
deviceCheck.description: The device-side verification chain failed. Inspect device-logcat, smoke-test-report, build-report, and APK outputs first, then use failure category {{category}} to determine whether the device was unavailable, install failed, or the app crashed after launch.

profileCheck.title: Template or structural check failed
profileCheck.description: The generated result no longer satisfies the template or structural constraints. Inspect build-report and the event stream first, then use failure category {{category}} to verify target files, entry wiring, and persistence wiring.

generic.title: Capture evidence before retrying
generic.description: The task already exposes failure_context, but no specialized hint matched yet. Preserve the event stream, summary log, and builder output first, then decide whether to recompile, restart, or continue manual triage.

notifications.title: Action center
notifications.description: Prioritize human actions and system reminders related to the current job.
notifications.empty: There are no pending notifications right now.

workflowHint.title: Current delivery guidance
workflowHint.changes_requested: Document the requested changes first, then refresh the review / handoff artifacts and supporting evidence.
workflowHint.approved_for_signing: The package passed delivery review. Prepare signing outputs next and attach the signed file paths.
workflowHint.signed: Signed artifacts are ready. Select a release channel and move toward staged or full release.
workflowHint.staged: The release is in staged rollout. Record the channel, rollout ratio, and validation evidence before deciding on full release.
workflowHint.released: The release is now live. Keep attaching follow-up evidence and release feedback as it comes in.

followUpHint.monitoring: The release is live. Keep collecting production feedback, crash signals, and channel performance evidence.
followUpHint.stable: Post-release signals look stable. Capture the final conclusion and closing evidence.
followUpHint.issue_detected: A post-release issue was detected. Attach the evidence immediately and drive rollback or a new delivery decision.
